stem.text: A wire of circular cross-section, which obeys Hooke's law, is used to suspend a basket as shown.

stem.alt: Wire hanging from a grey ceiling bar, supporting a grey basket. The wire is labelled wire and the basket is labelled basket.

stem.text: The Young modulus for the material of the wire is $2.5 \times 10^{11}\,\text{Pa}$.
When a weight of $34\,\text{N}$ is added to the basket, the strain in the wire increases by $6.0 \times 10^{-5}$.
What is the radius of the wire?
